advisories.title: bigint-buffer Vulnerable to Buffer Overflow via toBigIntLE() Function
advisories.category: Backend SDK dependency; browser native code unavailable
advisories.reachabilityBefore: SPL buffer-layout-utils can call integer conversions, but native builds were already disabled and production contained no bigint native addon. The memory-corruption advisory concerns the native converter, not the pure-JS implementation.
advisories.action: No patched upstream release exists. Retain allowBuilds.bigint-buffer=false and force only dist/browser.js in the production backend bundle; fail the build if dist/node.js is included.
advisories.residual: One high registry advisory remains. No demonstrated native-overflow exposure in the guarded build; alternative build paths, future dependency changes and upstream supply-chain risk still require review.

publishedPatchVerification.note: npm audit advertises >=1.1.6, but that release is not published; do not claim an available fix.

advisories.title: uuid: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided
advisories.category: Backend/browser RPC dependency; vulnerable functions unused
advisories.reachabilityBefore: Jayson uses UUID v4 for RPC request IDs. The advisory requires v3/v5/v6 with caller-provided output buffers; those calls are absent from application authentication and launch paths. Application IDs use node:crypto.
advisories.action: Jayson 5.0.0 uses platform cryptography for request IDs and removes uuid@8 from its dependency closure. Existing safe uuid@14 elsewhere is retained.

advisories.title: stream-json: pick/ignore/filter/replace filters are O(depth²) on nested input — small crafted JSON blocks the event loop for seconds→minutes (DoS)
advisories.category: Transitive RPC server tooling; unused by the production RPC client
advisories.reachabilityBefore: Only Jayson streaming server utilities require this package. Solana web3 uses Jayson browser client; no application streaming-JSON server endpoint exists. Before-review and rebuilt self-contained server source maps contain no stream-json source.
advisories.action: Jayson 5.0.0 removes stream-json instead of forcing an incompatible ESM parser into old CommonJS paths.

advisories.title: toml-node: Uncontrolled Recursion
advisories.category: Bundled Anchor workspace tooling; parser not exposed by application routes
advisories.reachabilityBefore: Anchor workspace loader imports TOML and parses local Anchor.toml only on workspace access. Application Pump construction uses explicit SDK IDLs, not user-provided TOML or anchor.workspace.
advisories.action: Scoped override on Anchor 0.31.1 replaces toml 3.0.0 with 5.0.1. CommonJS parse(string/Buffer) behavior and prototype safety are regression-tested. Node >=20 is compatible with the project Node >=22 requirement.

advisories.title: Vitest: Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read via @vitest/mocker Redirect Mock
advisories.category: Development/test tooling; not in production runtime

advisories.action: Use minimum patched maintained branch ~4.1.12; do not jump to latest major 5. Matching Vitest packages are 4.1.12.

advisories.category: Development/test tooling; not in production runtime

advisories.action: Upgrade through Vitest 4.1.12; no incompatible standalone mocker override.

advisories.title: Tinypool: Prototype Pollution gadget in worker options leads to Remote Code Execution
advisories.category: Development/test tooling; not in production runtime
advisories.reachabilityBefore: Prototype-pollution gadgets require prior pollution plus a worker-pool operation. Tinypool was a Vitest-only dependency and absent from the deployed server/frontend runtime.
advisories.action: Vitest 4.1.12 no longer depends on tinypool, removing the vulnerable dependency instead of forcing a major worker-pool override.

advisories.action: Patch each existing major independently: 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 and 4.2.2 to 4.2.3.

compatibilityNotes: Pump SDK 4.1.0, backend Solana web3 1.99.0, frontend Solana web3 1.98.4 and frontend Vite 7.3.7 remain unchanged.
Three existing tests re-wrapped mock spies. Vitest 4 reuses spies, so those wrappers now capture getMockImplementation() to prevent recursion; no production recovery code or assertions were weakened.
Existing optional ws@7.5.13 peer mismatch (utf-8-validate ^5 versus installed 6) predates this update. Native accelerators stay disabled/external and pure-JS fallback remains available.
Legacy apps/web/package-lock.json is preserved and refreshed, with the same Jayson override for npm metadata. Production/build source of truth remains root pnpm-lock.yaml.

initialRunFindings: Vitest 4 reuses existing spies; two recovery tests recursively wrapped their own spy. Capturing getMockImplementation() fixes the test wrappers without changing recovery code or assertions. The same pattern was corrected in a disabled legacy USDC test.

The signed-receipt PostgreSQL suite requires a pre-migrated schema, while other suites deliberately reset it. All 50 other backend files were rerun successfully; existing migrations were then applied only to the fresh private database and the guarded persistence file passed separately.

databaseIsolation.cluster: fresh private /tmp cluster, Unix socket permissions 0700, TCP disabled
databaseIsolation.migrations: Existing 001–005 only, applied to new disposable test databases
databaseIsolation.signedRecovery: verified across an actual child process restart; exact payload and wallet isolation preserved

validation.physicalWalletAcceptance: Not repeated; physical mobile on-chain acceptance remains deferred as previously accepted.

nextActions: Obtain separate approval before deploying the tested dependency updates. Current production has not received these changes.
Monitor bigint-buffer / Solana buffer-layout-utils for a genuine patched upstream release; retain the forced pure-JS build guard until then.
This review is not an independent penetration test or a guarantee against unknown vulnerabilities.
remainingRisks: bigint-buffer 1.1.5 remains an unpatched upstream package and a high audit finding. The native-overflow implementation is absent from the guarded production bundle; native builds remain disabled. This mitigation is not an upstream patch or a claim of zero risk.

Jayson and TOML security overrides exceed their parents original semver ranges. Used APIs, signatures, instruction bytes, uploads and recovery pass regression checks, but upstream vendor certification is not claimed; review/remove overrides when parent dependencies adopt fixed versions.
No production deployment was performed. Live production does not receive the fixes or stronger bundle mitigation until separately approved.
NPM advisory/source reachability review is not an independent penetration test, container-OS CVE scan or physical-wallet acceptance test.
